questions.stem: A grouped frequency table has the class $10 \leq x < 20$. What is the midpoint of this class?
Why can you only estimate the mean from a grouped frequency table?

options.text: Because the groups are too wide
Because you do not know the exact data values within each group
Because there are not enough data values
Because grouped tables always have errors

questions.explanation: In a grouped table, the individual data values are lost — you only know how many fall in each class. The midpoint is used as a representative value, making the calculated mean an estimate.
